        \ JOIN zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement s\n  ON p.utr_no_ = s.settlement_id\n  AND s.is_active = true\nWHERE p.is_active\
        \ = true\nGROUP BY p.transaction_date, p.utr_no_, p.gross_amount\nORDER BY p.transaction_date;"
      sql_pattern_id: sql.snapdeal.8_2_payment_vs_settlement_reconciliation

      - settlement_id

      \ s\n  ON n.sub_order_no = s.item_id\n  AND s.is_active = true\n  AND LOWER(s.type) LIKE '%tds inv%'\nWHERE n.is_active\

      sql_template: "SELECT\n  type,\n  COUNT(*) AS records,\n  SUM(charged_amount) AS gross_gmv,\n  SUM(commission) AS total_commission,\n\
        \  SUM(courier_fee) AS courier_fees,\n  SUM(closing_fee) AS closing_fees,\n  SUM(marketing_fee) AS marketing_fees,\n\
        \  SUM(payment_collection_fee) AS payment_fees,\n  SUM(discount) AS discounts,\n  SUM(cash_discount_adjustment) AS\
        \ cashback_adj,\n  SUM(tax_igst_amount + tax_cgst_amount + tax_sgst_amount) AS gst_on_fees,\n  SUM(settled_amount)\
        \ AS net_settled\nFROM zs_observe.snapdeal_settlement\nWHERE is_active = true\nGROUP BY type\nORDER BY records DESC;"
      parameters:

      - source_schema
